items.name: Dedica
items.tagline: Check if AI agents can use your website
items.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

items.name: bytemail
items.tagline: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers
items.description: bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

items.name: BotGauge
items.tagline: The trust layer for your agents
items.description: AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

items.name: Fraud Blocker
items.tagline: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads
items.description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

items.name: Tulu
items.tagline: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs
items.description: Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

items.name: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
items.tagline: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services
items.description: Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

items.name: LFM3 by Liquid AI
items.tagline: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots
items.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

items.name: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
items.tagline: Abliterated open models for security work
items.description: Security research often involves questions that general-purpose models refuse Meet Dolly 1 Security and Dolly 2 Security, uncensored variants of GLM-5.3 Flash and GLM-5.3 for defensive testing and red-team workflows. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

items.name: Genie 4
items.tagline: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer
items.description: Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

items.name: App Store Screenshots
items.tagline: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots
items.description: A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Give your agent your app captures and a short brief, and it builds a local screenshot editor in your project. Choose from 18 styles, compare looks in Style Lab, edit the copy, and export every size for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android, in multiple languages. No screenshot subscription. It runs locally; your usual agent costs apply. Install: npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots

items.name: TONKO
items.tagline: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money
items.description: A pocket money app for families: kids earn through jobs, split every euro into Spend, Save and Grow jars, save for goals and learn money skills in short lessons — a parent approves every step. No ads, no bank card. Free on Android.

items.name: Hob
items.tagline: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT
items.description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

items.name: OpenLLM
items.tagline: Take your AI tokens anywhere
items.description: Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

items.name: throxy
items.tagline: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.
items.description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

items.name: WebAI by Opera
items.tagline: Let websites use AI running on your computer
items.description: You can now access local AI built into the browser to start creating your own browser capabilities instead of relying on others' extensions.

items.name: licenseal
items.tagline: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release
items.description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.

items.name: Basedash View-only members
items.tagline: Share dashboards with anyone. They can look, not edit.
items.description: Invite stakeholders, clients, or a whole department to Basedash as view-only members. They can open the dashboards, saved charts, automations, and chat history you share with them, run saved charts, use dashboard filters and drilldowns, and export results. They can't create or edit anything, run automations, or chat. Pick the role in the invite dialog, member settings, the API, or an embed sign-in token. Share the numbers, not the edit button.

items.name: AirPosture
items.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods
items.description: New since our March launch: a Mac app that lives in the menu bar and cues you from the notch, a voice coach that speaks in your AirPods, and coaching that keeps working with your phone locked. AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

items.name: OneDeploy
items.tagline: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees
items.description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.

items.name: RageLayer
items.tagline: Let visitors smash your website, then sweep it back
items.description: RageLayer is an Easter egg for your own site. Visitors pick a hammer, fire, chainsaw, or black hole and wreck the real page: text and cards break into physical debris, effects interact (water puts out fire), and a broom sweeps everything back. 15 tools. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML. Free, MIT, TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, plus an SDK for custom tools. Play with the live demo first.
